scares.description: A loud gunshot startles Jane as she arranges some flowers in a vase.
A sheet slips off the mirror behind Sam.
Jack looks through the hole in the ceiling and sees a corpse suddenly crawl past him.
Jane puts her hand through the hole to pet the raccoon, the ghost places his hand on top of hers.
Accompanied by a sound effect, Billy looks back into the room and sees a man holding a match.
